nodes.title: SpecSheriff's own guidelines
nodes.text: What only the specification of this repository needs beyond the SpecSheriff guidelines.

children.title: The specification is approved
children.reason: This repository holds no symbol of the system's code. Every test of its tools carries the SpecTag of the node it is written from. So as a draft the specification would only stop the tests from running at a push (§s-xhcmchcngykvn2k).

decisions.problem: The rule said the specification is live, a word of its own beside a node's statuses.
decisions.ruling: Carrying out the owner's decision on §s-qzthyh7yqvfhsa2 of that day: the specification is approved or a draft.

decisions.problem: The node was written before the rules of one thought to a sentence (s-juucyammgq4shq8) and of what is applied together (s-6j8ystpj2yzcchq), and before the names of the method were settled.
decisions.ruling: In the owner's name, carrying out those rules and the names the owner settled on 2026-11-07: the wording rewritten, its meaning unchanged.
